Cloud DevOps Engineer Job Summary: We are looking for a skilled Cloud DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in cloud platforms, automation, and DevOps best practices to ensure seamless deployment and operations

Key Responsibilities: Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment and testing

Implement containerization and orchestration solutions using Docker and Kubernetes

Monitor system performance, availability, and security using observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch

Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and scaling using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools

Collaborate with development teams to optimize application performance and troubleshoot production issues

Implement security best practices, access controls, and compliance measures in cloud environments

Requirements: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

Proven experience as a Cloud DevOps Engineer with expertise in AWS, Azure, or GCP

Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps

Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell

Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) technologies

Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability tools

Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills

Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

Certifications in AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, or related technologies are a plus

Job Title: Cloud DevOps Engineer Department: IT Operations Location: Powai, Mumbai / Pune / Bengaluru Experience: 3 - 8 Years Qualification: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field 16

Content Writer Job Summary: We are looking for a talented Content Writer to create engaging, informative, and high-quality content across various digital platforms

The ideal candidate will have excellent writing skills, creativity, and the ability to adapt tone and style to different audiences and formats

Key Responsibilities: Write, edit, and proofread content for websites, blogs, social media, email campaigns, and marketing materials

Conduct research on industry trends, topics, and keywords to create relevant and SEO-optimized content

Collaborate with marketing, product, and design teams to develop content strategies that align with business objectives

Develop compelling product descriptions, case studies, whitepapers, and thought leadership articles

Maintain consistency in brand voice, messaging, and tone across all content channels

Monitor content performance and optimize based on analytics and audience engagement metrics

Level 1 Helpdesk Executive Job Summary: We are seeking a customer-focused Level 1 Helpdesk Executive to provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance to end-users

The ideal candidate will have strong communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and a passion for delivering excellent customer service

Key Responsibilities: Provide first-level technical support to end-users via phone, email, or ticketing systems

Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, network, and application issues in a timely manner

Log, track, and manage support tickets using helpdesk software (ServiceNow, Zendesk, etc)

Escalate complex issues to Level 2 or Level 3 support teams as needed

Assist users with password resets, account management, and access permissions

Document technical issues, resolutions, and knowledge base articles for future reference

Maintain high customer satisfaction by providing professional, courteous, and efficient support

Requirements: Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field

Proven experience in helpdesk, technical support, or IT support roles

Strong knowledge of Windows, macOS, Microsoft Office, and common software applications

Familiarity with Active Directory, email systems, and remote support tools

Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills

Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple requests simultaneously

ITIL Foundation or relevant certifications are a plus

Experience with ticketing systems and IT service management tools is desirable
